thoughts: The current dwell time is extremely low, suggesting users are skimming the high-level numbers and bouncing because the layout feels like a standard 'features' block. By shifting to a BLUEPRINT strategy, we transform the section from a list of cards into a cohesive technical 'system'. We will use a more sophisticated color palette (Deep Navy and Copper) to evoke executive authority. The 'Evidence Items' are now decoupled from the testimonials to allow for a dual-scanning path: logic-driven stats for the left brain and narrative quotes for the right brain. The centered headline maintains alignment with the hero section while the grid below uses a structured 1280px container with technical 'architectural' markers (border-accents and mono-spaced sub-labels) to force eye-fixation and increase dwell time.
